default/31517.htm.text: Hierarch: Welcome, dear traveler! What brings you to this dark and gloomy place? You shouldn't be here! Go do your exploring somewhere else!

Q00015_SweetWhispers/31517-00.html.text: Hierarch: What are you doing here? We don't let just anybody in here!

Q00016_TheComingDarkness/31517-04.html.text: Hierarch: Quest Light and Darkness need to be finished first.

Q00016_TheComingDarkness/31517-00.htm.text: Hierarch: Brother, you've been with us for a long time! You've earned our trust, and therefore I believe you're ready for an important mission!

Q00016_TheComingDarkness/31517-05.html.text: Hierarch: We've spent much time together, dear brother, but I regret to tell you that you're not yet ready! Try again when your faith and conviction are more firmly established. (Only characters of level 62 and above may undertake this quest.)

Q00016_TheComingDarkness/31517-03.html.text: Hierarch: You've done well! Welcome to the brotherhood! You're now a member of the Benandanti Cartel! I'll see that you're well-rewarded!

Q00016_TheComingDarkness/31517-02a.html.text: Hierarch: You haven't finished your job yet! Come back when you've broken the seal. I'll be waiting.

Q00017_LightAndDarkness/31517-00.htm.text: Hierarch: Brother, you've been with us for a long time! You've earned our trust, and therefore I believe you're ready for an important mission! Are you up to the task?

Q00017_LightAndDarkness/31517-06.html.text: Heirarch: Quest Sweet Whispers need to be finished first.

Q00017_LightAndDarkness/31517-05.html.text: Heirarch: Where is the Blood of Saint I gave you? How could you betray our trust like that?! You are no longer our brother! Get out! We cast you out in the name of Triol! May your remaining days be full of terrible pain and suffering...

Q00017_LightAndDarkness/31517-04.html.text: Heirarch: You haven't finished your mission. Come back when you're done.

Q00017_LightAndDarkness/31517-03.html.text: Heirarch: Good job! We are really starting to trust you! Someday, perhaps, you'll be our true brother! Congratulations! Now choose your reward!

Q00626_ADarkTwilight/31517-01.htm.text: Hierarch: We think alike, you and me! Will you join us in our work to make this world a better place? We're making great advances every day, but there are some who are jealous and are trying to interfere with our work... They're keeping us from attaining our goal! Will you help us?

Q00626_ADarkTwilight/31517-00.htm.text: Hierarch: We think alike, you and me! Will you join us in our work to make this world a better place? We're making great advances every day, but there are some who are jealous and are trying to interfere with our work... They're keeping us from attaining our goal! You know, we really do need help, …

Q00626_ADarkTwilight/31517-03.html.text: Hierarch: Hey! What are you doing? You promised to help us! Bring justice to those Eyes of Splendor, Flashes of Splendor, Knife Edges of Splendor, Wisdom of Splendor, Souls of Splendor, Victories of Splendor, Vengeance of Splendor, Shouts of Splendor, Seals of Splendor, Crowns of Splendor and Waili…

Q00626_ADarkTwilight/31517-04.html.text: Hierarch: Have you brought the Blood of Saint? Your success has helped us achieve our goal! We couldn't have done it without you! Now choose your reward!

Q00015_SweetWhispers/31517-01.html.text: Hierarch: Oh, he sent you! Fine! We'll be working together then! Your first task will only be a test. After I assess your ability, I'll assign you a mission that's more appropriate for you. Come back later.

Q00016_TheComingDarkness/31517-01.htm.text: Hierarch: You're very well prepared! I wish all of us could be as well prepared as you! You've chosen a path that holds many trials, one that your brothers have traveled before you! Do you have the faith you'll need to complete your journey?

Q00016_TheComingDarkness/31517-02.htm.text: Hierarch: Very well. Based on the trust we have for you, brother, I'll give you a mission. Use these five crystals of binding to break open the seals that have been placed throughout this region. Watch the altar carefully; you'll discover how to use these crystals. I'll wait here until you break al…

Q00017_LightAndDarkness/31517-01.htm.text: Hierarch: Before I tell you, I need to ask you something. How strong is your faith in the work that we do? Are you certain that you can persevere no matter what happens while carrying out this mission?

Q00017_LightAndDarkness/31517-02.html.text: Hierarch: Very well, brother. Listen carefully! Go to the Altar of Saints, sprinkle this Blood of Saint on it and then come back. You may think that this sounds simple... But I warn you... Unless your faith in us is very strong, you won't complete this mission! So go sprinkle the blood on the Altar…

Q00017_LightAndDarkness/31517-02a.html.text: Heirarch: We've spent much time together, dear brother, but I regret to tell you that you're not yet ready! Try again when your faith and conviction are more firmly established. (Only characters of level 61 and above may undertake this quest.)

Q00626_ADarkTwilight/31517-02.htm.text: Hierarch: Your passionate resolve is breathtaking! Your job is deceptively simple! You must merely exterminate those execrable servants of Einhasad that infest this altar. They're called the Eye of Splendor, Flash of Splendor, Blade of Splendor, Wisdom of Splendor, Soul of Splendor, Victory of Sple…

Q00626_ADarkTwilight/31517-05.html.text: Hierarch: Here you go! Take your pick! Of course, you must first give me 300 units of Blood of Saint. Just put it over there. Now choose your reward!

Q00626_ADarkTwilight/31517-06.html.text: Hierarch: You said you brought them, so where are they? Are you some kind of a trickster?

Q00626_ADarkTwilight/31517-07.html.text: Hierarch: Good choice! I hope you're satisfied! The proofs you brought will be very useful to us. Just wait!
